<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum lists the chemical shift values for each carbon. Identical shift values correspond to chemically equivalent carbons. The distinct shift values are: 147.00, 133.90, 128.91, 127.68, 44.06, 34.54, 26.90, and 26.18. That gives 8 unique carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>8</final_answer>
